Bind every programme claim to PURE_WEYL_PROGRAMME_PHASE1_CLASSIFICATION_ENDING_V1 and its frozen dependencies. body.current_gate: stable Phase-1 synthesis and portal/paper genre separation
body.forbid: no new scientific inference; no theory/background conflation; no universal ghost/no-go claim; no nondegenerate classical pairing called a quantum norm; no counterflow finite-block instability called a full-PDE theorem; no strict/compensator/counterflow conflation; no fixture black-hole result called general; no literature priority claim without an explicit source; no changelog, queue or active-project material in Paper 15
